content: Juda na Tama
Mbaŋa ubotu e ghereiye, Juda i iteteŋgiya ogaghae na i nja ve yaku weiye amala regha idae Hira e ghemba idae Adulam.
Gheko Juda i thuwe wevo eunda tɨnan Kenan ramae idae Sua. I vaŋgu na i ghena weiye.
Wevoko i marabo na i ghambɨ ŋgama ghɨmoru. I rena idae Er.
Muyai mbowo i ghambɨva, na tembe ŋgama ghɨmoruva. I rena idae Onan.
Injana mbowo i marabova na tembe i ghambɨva ŋgama ghɨmoru. I rena idae Sila. Ŋgamake iyake va ve virɨ e ghemba regha idae Kesib.
Mbaŋa Er kaero i thamatuwo, Juda nariye virɨviva, kaero ramae i tuthiya levo, idae Tama.
Ko iyemaeŋge Juda nariye virɨviva le vakatha mbema tharɨ eŋge vara Loi e marae. Iya kaiwae Loi i vakatha na i mare.

Iwaeŋge Juda i dage weya nariye Onan, Er ghaghae, iŋa, “U vaŋgwa ghaghako laghɨyeniye ghembwiye na u vamboromboro ghanda thanavu me mena orumburumbunda weŋgi. Kaiwae mbe ghagha levo, mbala u ghambɨ wein ghaghako kaiwae.”

Ko iyemaeŋge Onan va i ghareghare gamagaiko ne thɨ ghambɨko weiye maane amalaghɨniye idae ina weŋgi; iya kaiwae mbaŋa i ghena weiye wambwiko riwaeko dimithiye i liŋgiyathu eto mbala wambwiko maa i marabo na i ghambɨ gamagai ghaghaema kaiwae.
Le vakathako kaiwae Loi maa i warari iya kaiwae tembe i vakatha na i mareva.

Amba Juda i dage weya ghendiyae Tama iŋa, “U njogha weya rama na len bodaboda na wo vo yaku weinaŋgi, ko thava ne u ghe, na naruŋguke Sila wo i thamatuwo.” Kaiwae le renuwaŋako va iŋa, “Ne iwaeŋge mbowo i mareva ŋgoreiya oghaghaeko.” Tama i vakatha ŋgoreiya Juda le renuwaŋako.

Mbaŋa molao kaero iko na e ghereiye Juda levo iye Sua yawarumbuye, i mare. Mbaŋa le nuwatharɨko ghambaŋa kaero iko, amba i voro Timɨna weŋgiya ghɨmoghɨmoru thɨ tena le sipɨko vulivulinji wul kaiwae. Hira, rara Adulam, Juda le nɨma, vambe weiyeva.
Mbaŋa lolo regha i dage weya Tama iŋa, “Ghendiyae Juda i wareri i wa Timɨna ve tena le sipɨko vulivulinji wul kaiwae,”

iwaeŋge i biginjoŋa wambwima kwamaniye, i liyabo riwae e kwama ulu ghayaboyabo na i wothuwole ghayamoyamo. Ko amba ve yaku e kamwathɨ ruru Enain, e kamwathɨ i voro Timɨna. Kaiwae vama i thuwe Sila kaero i thamatuwo, ko iyemaeŋge ghendiyae maa i vaŋgugiyawe na le ghɨmoru.
Mbaŋa Juda i thuwe le renuwaŋa iŋaeŋge wevo i vavakuneŋa riwae, kaiwae i yabo ghamwae.

Kaiwae Juda mava ele ghareghare elako amalaghɨniye ghendiyae, iwaeŋge i loŋga ghembe e kamwathɨko ghadidiye na i dagewe iŋa, “U mena e mbaŋake iyake na ya ghena weiŋgu ghen.” Elako i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Ne u giya modaŋgu budakai?”

I dagewe iŋa, “Ne ya variya gout nariye elo sip na goutɨko tɨnenji.” Ko iyemaeŋge elako i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Thare valɨkaiwae u giyama bigi regha e ghino na ne i vaemunjoruŋa dagerawena ne u variya goutɨna nariye e ghino.”

Juda i dagewe iŋa, “Nuwaniya ya woveŋge budakai?” I gonjoghawe iŋa, “Nuwaŋguiya ghan nonona weiye ghathiyona na pwasikena iya e nɨmanɨna.” Kaero i giyawe na i vamboromboro Juda le renuwaŋako. E vakathako iyako Tama i marabo.
E ghereiye Tama i njogha, i biginjoŋa ulu ghayaboyabo na kaero i njimbova wambwima kwamaniye.

Mbaŋa Juda ve vutha weŋgiya rakakaiwoma, i tuthiya gout nariye tabwagha regha, kaero i variye weiye le nɨma Hira na mbala ve biginjogha me le dagerawema i giya le bigibigima weya elama. Ko iyemaeŋge le nima maa ve vaidi.
Iwaeŋge i vaitoŋgiya ghɨmoghɨmoru thiya yaku gheko iŋa, “Aŋga ina elama i vakuneŋa riwaema e yathima thanavuniye?” Thɨ thombenjoghawe, thɨŋa, “Ma wevo i vakuneŋa riwae ina gheke.”
Kaero i njoghava weya Juda na i dagewe iŋa, “Maa ma vaidi mun. Ghɨmoghɨmoru inanji e ghembako iyako methɨ dage e ghino thɨŋa, ‘Ma tembe wevo regha i vakuneŋa riwae iri gheke.’”

Juda i gonjoghawe iŋa, “U viyathu na i mbana budakai menda ya giyanawe. Thava tembe ra tamwe mbeleva, ne iwaeŋge gharɨgharɨ thɨ loŋwevaidi na thɨ vavɨrɨinda. Kaero ma mando na ya vamboromboro le renuwaŋa na ma variye goutɨma, ko iyemaeŋge maa mo vaidi.”

Manjala umboto e ghereiye lolo regha i utugiya weya Juda iŋa, “Ghendiyae Tama mendava i vakatha yathima thanavuniye, na mbaŋake kaero i marabo.” Juda iŋa, “Hu vaŋguraŋgiyama etoke na ra ŋambu vamare e ndɨghe.”

Ko iyemaeŋge mbaŋa vethɨ vaŋguraŋgiya kaero i variye totoke iyake weya ghendiyae iŋa, “Ghɨmoruke iya le bigibigiya thiyake iye va weiŋgu, iya maraboniyake.” Na i gotubweva iŋa, “Mbowo u thuwe bigibigike thiyake. Thela le bigibigi? Ghanono weiye ghathiyo na pwasike.”

Mbaŋa Juda i thuwe bigibigiko theghetoko na i ghareghare amalaghɨniyewe, iwaeŋge iŋa, “Tama le vakatha i emunjoru, ko iyemaeŋge ghino lo tharɨ, kaiwae mava ya vaŋgugiya naruŋguko Sila weya elaghɨniye na le ghɨmoru.” Na ande teva i ghenareva weiye Tama.
Mbaŋa kaero ghambaŋa ghambɨ, ghɨmoghɨmoru theghewo gamwaruwoŋgi va inanji e ŋgamoiye.
Tama ele ghambɨko tɨne ŋgamako regha i liraŋgiya nɨmae regha, ravavaghambɨko eunda i li thiyo sosoro nasiye na i ŋgarɨ e nɨmaeko amba iŋa, “Ŋgamake iyake ne i virɨkai.”
Ko iyemaeŋge mbaŋa i liruwo njogha nɨmae ghaghaeko i virɨkai, iwaeŋge ravavaghambɨ iŋa, “Ko ana ghen u virɨviva weva ghaghana!” Iya kaiwae thɨ rena idae Peres.
Amba ghaghaema thiyoma nasiye sosoro ina e nɨmae i virɨ, na thɨ rena idae Sera.
